title: DoubleFree:Exploiting Exploration History for Rollout-Free Multi-Task LLMs Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.34272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-task post-training can develop domain specialists through independent reinforcement learning (RL) and consolidate their capabilities through multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). However, standard MOPD generates on-policy student responses and keeps multiple teachers online throughout consolidation, introducing substantial system costs. We view this pipeline as domain-wise exploration followed by cross-domain exploitation. Domain RL produces not only the final specialists, but also the trajectories collected throughout their training. Existing methods primarily use the former while leaving the latter underutilized. We introduce DoubleFree, which reuses these historical trajectories for rollout-free consolidation and precomputes teacher supervision for online-teacher-free student training. translated_title: DoubleFree：利用探索历史实现无需Rollout的多任务大语言模型训练
translated_abstract: 多任务后训练可以通过独立的强化学习（RL）培养领域专家，并通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）来整合它们的能力。然而，标准的MOPD需要生成在线策略的学生响应，并在整个整合过程中保持多个教师模型在线，这带来了巨大的系统开销。我们将这一流程视为按领域进行的探索，随后进行跨领域的利用。领域强化学习不仅产出最终的专家模型，还在其训练过程中收集了大量轨迹。现有方法主要利用前者，而后者却未被充分利用。我们提出DoubleFree，它复用这些历史轨迹以实现无需rollout的整合，并通过预计算教师监督信号，实现无需在线教师的学生训练。为了理解其有效原因，我们分析了在何种条件下基于历史轨迹的更新能够近似在线策略蒸馏的更新……
tldr: DoubleFree通过复用领域强化学习训练过程中积累的历史轨迹实现无需rollout的多任务整合，并利用预计算的教师监督信号摆脱对在线教师模型的依赖，从而大幅降低多任务大语言模型训练的系统成本。
en_tdlr: DoubleFree reuses exploration trajectories from domain RL training for rollout-free multi-task consolidation and employs precomputed teacher supervision to eliminate online teachers, significantly reducing system costs in multi-task LLM training.
